newsitem.title: USA: Colonial Pipeline running after lightning incident.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Pipeline running after lightning incident.

text.p: Colonial Pipeline said Thursday its 1.2 million barrel-per-day gasoline line has returned to normal deliveries following a lightning strike at its Atlanta, Georgia, tank farm late yesterday.
Operations along the Pasadena, Texas, to Greensboro, North Carolina, line were suspended for one hour late Wednesday after lightning ignited a vapor fire in one of the gasoline tanks.
"Line 1 was not shut down. We just closed out deliveries to Atlanta until the fire was put out," said Bob Krug, a Colonial scheduler, referring to the gasoline line.
The Houston-to-New York Colonial Pipeline is the largest refined products pipeline in America and pumps nearly 20 percent of total daily U.S. refined products demand.
The gasoline line runs alongside a distillate line.
